name: codex-monitor-hud
description: A lightweight real-time multi-task HUD for Codex Desktop on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight live monitoring for concurrent Codex tasks.
interface.longDescription: A local-first real-time HUD for high-concurrency Codex workflows. Keep one compact summary, expand a stable numbered task list, split selected tasks into independent bubbles, or opt in to targeted CODEX-labeled mid-task notices while Codex keeps working in the background.
defaultPrompt: Explain and configure proactive Codex notices
Repair or restart Codex Monitor HUD
